objective: Implement the authorized first end-to-end Hive Plan cockpit vertical slice with deterministic, truthful runtime state, PostgreSQL persistence, snapshot+SSE projections, adaptive/optional Hive Core visualization, read-only ecosystem seams, and exact-head evidence while minimizing executor architectural discretion.
scope: Bootstrap the bounded pnpm monorepo and localhost-first Docker Compose runtime.
Create shared versioned cockpit DTO/schema contracts and negative-state fixtures.
Create PostgreSQL 18 minimum canonical schema, migrations, persistence adapters, development-only labeled fixture path, and restart/recovery proof.
Create Fastify API snapshot endpoints, truthful projection builders, SSE watermark delta transport, and reconnect/reconciliation behavior.
Create React/Vite cockpit shell with project navigation, Engineering Workspace, Live System Rail, telemetry strip, design tokens, semantic runtime states, accessibility, and responsive density.
Create optional Hive Core MVP with VisualTruthMirror and adaptive graphics/fallback behavior.
Create read-only HIVE/UADS/UGAS adapter interfaces/stubs with explicit NOT_CONNECTED/DEGRADED/UNKNOWN behavior and zero external mutation.
Create deterministic unit/contract/integration/browser/accessibility/performance/security/recovery evidence harnesses and exact-head evidence manifest.
out_of_scope: Full Engineering Chat LLM execution or Project Brain/HIVE RAG integration.
UADS host dispatch as a product feature.
Cloud authentication, public multi-user/SaaS, billing, plan enforcement, teams or marketplace.
Mandatory Redis, Kubernetes, microservices, product-wide event sourcing, separate vector database.
Complete model router/cost engine, full vector/RAG schema, unrelated refactors.
Any mutation of HIVE, UADS or UGAS repositories/services.
must_not_touch: HIVE/UADS/UGAS external repositories or mutable external state
Frozen HP-WO-0001 scope/acceptance criteria except through governed recompile
Unrelated project architecture or release history

Fastify API, snapshot/SSE transport, projection services and adapter seams.

symbol_plan.responsibility: Single complete browser projection with schema version, project identity, watermark, freshness and bounded summaries.
Versioned SSE delta envelope with event identity, project, base/next watermark, class, time and payload.
Frontend projection state that applies only valid in-order deltas and requests reconciliation on mismatch/gap.
Reject wrong-project, stale-base and otherwise incompatible deltas.
Coalesce/drop only permitted telemetry/decorative classes while preserving critical/state-transition ordering.
Persist/load bounded project and runtime state from PostgreSQL.
Build truthful projection DTOs from canonical/verified sources without fabricating success.
Read-only status/capability observation seam for HIVE/UADS/UGAS/GitHub.
Optional adaptive spatial projection of already-known state; never authority.
DOM/2D semantic equivalent for every critical Hive Core state.
Select/degrade graphics profile based on capability/resource pressure without changing assurance.
Bind final head/base, commands, proofs and artifacts to exact implementation state.

data_flow: PostgreSQL canonical records -> repository/service layer -> ProjectCockpitProjection builder -> GET snapshot.
Canonical/verified state transition -> workflow/event record -> CockpitDeltaEnvelope -> SSE -> ProjectionFence -> CockpitProjectionStore.
On base watermark mismatch, wrong project or provable gap -> reject delta -> fetch fresh snapshot -> replace projection -> resume stream from accepted watermark.
HIVE/UADS/UGAS adapter observation -> explicit status envelope -> projection summary; unreachable/unconfigured never becomes healthy/current.
CockpitProjectionStore selectors -> DOM operational UI and optional Hive Core; 3D never writes business truth.
Implementation/test runtime -> evidence harness -> exact-head EvidenceManifest -> review inputs.
algorithm_plan: Bootstrap in dependency order: repository/workspace -> shared contracts -> database -> API/projection transport -> UI -> Hive Core/adapters -> evidence finalization.
Implement freshness as an explicit enum and carry observed/generated timestamps/revisions. Never map null/missing/timeout to zero or SUCCESS.

For SSE, maintain current watermark per project. Apply event only when project matches and base_watermark equals current watermark. Duplicates are idempotent. Any unprovable gap forces snapshot reconciliation.

PulseMux may reduce TELEMETRY_LATEST, TELEMETRY_SAMPLE and DECORATIVE_SIGNAL only. It must preserve CRITICAL_STATE and STATE_TRANSITION semantic ordering and count produced/received/applied/coalesced/dropped events.
Persist only bounded canonical state in PostgreSQL. Keep UI/3D state, projections and high-frequency telemetry derived/non-canonical.
Development seed/fixture path must require explicit dev/test mode and mark the project LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_FIXTURE in persisted/projected/UI surfaces.
Hive Core reads projection selectors only and degrades WebGPU -> WebGL2 -> reduced/static -> VisualTruthMirror. Critical state remains available through DOM.
Adapters expose read-only status/capabilities methods. No write/mutate/install/deploy/auth-changing operation exists in HP-WO-0001 adapter interface.
Evidence generation runs after final implementation head is fixed. Any subsequent code/config/test change invalidates exact-head evidence and requires regeneration.
contracts: Use React 19.3+ strict TypeScript, Vite 8.1+/Rolldown, TanStack Router/Query, small project-owned CockpitProjectionStore.
Use Node.js 24 LTS + Fastify; modular monolith + bounded worker processes; REST snapshots/commands + SSE by default.
PostgreSQL 18 is canonical durable first-slice store. Redis remains optional/non-canonical and should not be introduced unless proven necessary inside scope.
Shared DTO families and endpoint responsibilities from docs/83 are frozen.
Freshness vocabulary is CURRENT, STALE, DEGRADED, UNKNOWN, NOT_CONNECTED, NOT_AVAILABLE.
Event classes are CRITICAL_STATE, STATE_TRANSITION, TELEMETRY_LATEST, TELEMETRY_SAMPLE, DECORATIVE_SIGNAL.
Projection DTOs exclude secrets/tokens, unrestricted filesystem paths, raw environment values, hidden reasoning, unredacted provider payloads and arbitrary HTML.
Minimum persistence responsibilities from docs/84 are frozen; exact library/column syntax is implementation-local.
Critical information cannot exist only in 3D/canvas.
External ecosystem seams are read-only/no-mutation in this Work Order.
error_handling: Invalid/mismatched projection schema or unsupported major version: reject and surface DEGRADED/compatibility error, never guess.
SSE disconnect: bounded reconnect with jitter; if event continuity cannot be proven, fetch full snapshot.
Wrong-project/stale-base/gap delta: reject, record reason, reconcile via fresh snapshot.
PostgreSQL unavailable: API/UI expose DEGRADED/UNKNOWN with reason; do not synthesize current data.
Adapter unavailable/unconfigured: return NOT_CONNECTED or NOT_AVAILABLE according to contract; no success synthesis.
WebGPU/WebGL failure: degrade graphics path while preserving VisualTruthMirror.
Secret sentinel detected in browser/log/evidence boundary: fail test/evidence gate.
Scope mismatch or required write outside owned set: stop with SCOPE_EXPANSION_REQUIRED or BLUEPRINT_DEVIATION, do not improvise.
edge_cases: Old delta arriving after fresh snapshot.
Reconnect after server restarted and watermark history no longer proves continuity.
Project switched while events from prior project are in flight.
Missing cost/health data must render NOT_AVAILABLE/UNKNOWN, not 0/healthy.
HIVE configured but unreachable versus never configured.
PostgreSQL restart during active browser session.
WebGPU absent, WebGL2 absent, explicit 3D disabled.
Event storm while operator navigates/focuses controls.
Development fixture accidentally requested in non-development profile.
Evidence generated, then implementation file changes.
failure_shield: Prevent numeric documentation-prefix collisions by not creating planning docs in this implementation unless necessary and by checking existing paths first.
Do not equate process reachability with ecosystem health.
Do not convert missing/stale telemetry into zero-success values.
Do not allow 3D rendering to become a correctness dependency.
Do not accept executor completion claims as evidence.
Do not preserve evidence across head changes.
Do not expand to Redis/microservices/vector infrastructure because they appear convenient.
Do not let shared contracts drift independently after frontend/backend consumers start; serialize and reconcile such changes.
Do not let local fixtures fabricate operational success or leak into normal runtime.
Do not let multi-agent parallelism write overlapping files without ownership reconciliation.
test_plan: Root clean-checkout install/build/typecheck/test command succeeds from documented prerequisites.
Schema/DTO tests cover valid/invalid versions/enums, no-secret fields and stale/unknown propagation.
SSE reducer/transport tests cover order, duplicate, wrong project, stale base, gap, reconnect and snapshot reconciliation.
Migration tests cover empty database, repeat-safe migration runner behavior and restart persistence.
Browser tests cover cockpit startup, project switcher, navigation rail, Engineering Workspace, Live System Rail, graphics selector and return-to-primary-workspace using keyboard only.
Reduced-motion browser run verifies no required information/control depends on animation.
Nine exact visual states from docs/82a are captured against exact head.
Graphics tests cover WebGPU, WebGL2 fallback, REDUCED and disabled/SAFE_2D semantics through VisualTruthMirror.
Adapter contract tests prove explicit disconnected/unknown behavior and zero mutation calls.

Event-storm benchmark asserts p95 projection/render main-thread task <50ms in 3D-disabled baseline, no projection-induced task >100ms, usable operator input and zero lost critical/state-transition events.
Security checks include repository/evidence secret scan, sentinel redaction, browser payload exclusion and security headers.
Recovery test persists required state, restarts PostgreSQL/app path and confirms truthful resumed projection without reseeding.
Evidence test verifies final base/head SHA, changed-file inventory and proof references.
evidence_plan: Record toolchain versions and root commands used.
Record exact base SHA and final head SHA.
Store nine-state screenshot/video index with exact-head binding.
Store SSE reconciliation report with deterministic cases.
Store event-storm counts/latencies/input evidence and graphics-profile result.
Store graphics fallback + VisualTruthMirror parity report.
Generate final machine-readable EvidenceManifest only after head is fixed.
observability: Structured service logs contain project/increment/event IDs but no secrets/raw env/provider payloads.
SSE metrics count connect/disconnect/reconnect, produced/received/applied/rejected/coalesced/dropped events and reconciliation reasons.
Projection carries freshness/generated/source watermark information needed by UI.
Database health and migration state are observable without exposing credentials.
Graphics governor exposes active profile/capability/degradation reason.
Adapter status exposes observed_at/source_revision/capabilities/reason with explicit availability state.
Evidence scripts emit deterministic pass/fail summary and exact command identity.
performance_budgets: 3D-disabled event-storm baseline: p95 main-thread projection/render task <50ms.
Operator navigation/input remains usable during event storm.
Zero lost CRITICAL_STATE and STATE_TRANSITION events.
Decorative work degrades before semantic state processing under pressure.
No fixed FPS promise for first-slice 3D; collect benchmark evidence by graphics profile.

No fabricated metrics/health/integration/review/CI state and no critical information only in 3D.

Must support PostgreSQL 18, reproducible migrations, parameterized queries, simple local Docker workflow and minimal dependency/abstraction overhead; record rationale/evidence.

decision_budget.criterion: Must reliably exercise coalescing/backpressure on target machine while remaining deterministic/repeatable; record rate and rationale.

implementation_sequence: P0 Preflight: verify branch, main/work-order/context-lock identities, critical source fingerprints and Node/Docker/PostgreSQL prerequisites; stop on stale lock.
P1 T1 bootstrap: root workspace, strict TS configs, package scripts, Compose and safe env templates. Prove clean install/build skeleton and localhost defaults.
P2 T2 contracts: implement shared DTOs/schemas, freshness/event enums, projection/delta envelopes and invalid/no-secret fixtures. Freeze consumer-facing shapes before dependent work.
P3 T3 data: select bounded migration/query library, create minimum schema/repositories/dev fixture guard and migration/restart tests.
P4 T4 backend: implement Fastify system/project/cockpit/health/ecosystem/activity/cost-context endpoints and SSE pipeline with ProjectionFence/PulseMux/reconciliation tests.
P5 T5 frontend: implement AppShell/CommandHeader/NavigationRail/EngineeringWorkspace/LiveSystemRail/TelemetryStrip and semantic states against contract fixtures/API.
P6 T7 adapters: implement read-only HIVE/UADS/UGAS status seams and mutation-spy tests; may overlap P4/P5 only with non-overlapping ownership.
P7 T6 Hive Core: implement optional projection-only 3D, VisualTruthMirror and graphics profiles after semantic UI works without 3D.
P8 T8 integration/evidence: browser keyboard/reduced-motion, visual matrix, event storm, reconnect, restart/recovery, security and exact-head evidence tooling.
P9 Stabilize: integrate all tasks, fix only in-scope defects, rerun complete test/evidence matrix after final code change.
P10 Completion: produce truthful Completion Manifest/evidence summary. Do not self-approve; hand exact head/evidence to Senior Review + independent audit.
stop_condition: Stop and report BLOCKED rather than claiming completion unless all applicable AC-01 through AC-15 are satisfied with exact-head evidence, Context Lock remains fresh, no unresolved scope expansion/material blueprint deviation exists, required visual/accessibility/performance/security/recovery evidence exists, and the Completion Manifest can truthfully report COMPLETED.
